text:
[LNUL.4.1] **Value level — null propagates.** Every operator other than
`and` / `or` ([LNUL.4.2]), `??` ([LNUL.8.9]) and `is` ([LNUL.4.9]) propagates
`null`: the arithmetic, bitwise ([LEXP.7.7]) and comparison operators, the
interval relational operators ([LINT.4.5]) and the regex match operators
([LREG.1.1]). Such an operator with a `null` operand, and no operand that faults
([LNUL.4.10]), yields `null` ("unknown"): with `s.state` absent, `s.state + 1`,
`s.state & 1`, `s.state > 85` and `s.state == 5` all evaluate to `null`. A regex
match on an absent string neither matches nor fails to match, so the activation
continues for neither `~` nor `!~` ([LNUL.4.3]).

**There is no exception.** `is null` / `is not null` ([LNUL.4.9]) are a
**different operator**, not a special case of this one, which is what makes
propagation uniform rather than nearly-uniform.

The examples are written with a **binding** whose value is absent rather than a
`null` literal, because a literal operand of `==` / `!=` is a compile error
([LNUL.4.4]).

alloy.name: lnul_4_1__value_op
alloy.note: One abstract operator over the tri-valued domain stands for every value-level operator the clause names -- arithmetic, bitwise, comparison, interval relational, regex match -- so the propagation law is stated for all of them at once; the operators themselves are not drawn, and the tie carries the law, not the operator set.

alloy.name: lnul_4_1__value_propagates_null
alloy.note: The law restated as a check over the abstract operator: a null operand yields null. A transcription of the fact above, for every operator class at once.

idris.name: iret_7_5__cmp_bool
idris.note: A null right operand of a Bool comparison yields null.

idris.name: iret_7_5__cmp_float
idris.note: A null right operand of a Float comparison yields null.

idris.name: iret_7_5__cmp_int
idris.note: A null right operand of an Int comparison yields null.

idris.name: iret_7_5__cmp_json
idris.note: A null right operand of a Json comparison yields null.

idris.name: iret_7_5__cmp_str
idris.note: A null right operand of a String comparison yields null.

idris.name: lexp_7_2__int_right
idris.note: A null right operand of Int arithmetic yields null.

idris.name: lexp_7_2__negate
idris.note: Unary minus of null is null.

idris.name: lexp_7_3__float_right
idris.note: A null right operand of Float arithmetic yields null.

idris.name: lnul_4_1__arith
idris.note: Arithmetic with a null operand yields null, over the fragment's six arithmetic operators (`Lexp_7_2__arith`: + - * / // %). The clause names more operators: the bitwise operators ([LEXP.7.7]) are not modelled.

idris.name: lnul_4_1__arith_null_left
idris.note: Quantified over every operator of `Lexp_7_2__arith` and every right operand.

idris.name: lnul_4_1__arith_null_right
idris.note: Quantified over every operator of `Lexp_7_2__arith` and every left operand.

idris.name: lnul_4_1__cmp
idris.note: A comparison with a null operand yields null -- == included, with no exception -- over the six comparison operators (`Iret_7_5__cmp`). The clause names more operators: the interval relational operators ([LINT.4.5]) and the regex match operators ([LREG.1.1]) are not modelled.

idris.name: lnul_4_1__cmp_null_left
idris.note: Quantified over every operator of `Iret_7_5__cmp` and every right operand, == included.

idris.name: lnul_4_1__cmp_null_right
idris.note: Quantified over every operator of `Iret_7_5__cmp` and every left operand.

idris.name: lnul_4_1__null_or_trap
idris.note: The right operand once the left has no answer to give: null propagates, anything else is ill-typed.

idris.name: lnul_4_3__null_comparison_never_fires
idris.note: Propagation is what makes the comparison null, and not null is null.

idris.name: lnul_4_7__null_comparison_blocks
idris.note: Propagation is what makes the comparison null under no.

idris.name: lnul_8_4__path
idris.note: A path read on a `null` root (a `Json?` slot holding none) yields `null`: read as the clause's propagation, which it states of arithmetic and comparison operators and not of a path.
